brief:
**BLUF:** A Tazewell man with dementia reported missing Wednesday was found safe Thursday in the Bluefield area. A woman wanted in a recent Bluefield bar shooting was arrested in South Carolina. Tazewell County supervisors approved a countywide fire department roster and purchased property for a women’s opioid recovery center.[[1]](https://wcyb.com/news/local/tazewell-police-department-searching-for-90-year-old-man-who-has-dementia-lloyd-william-yates)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
- **Missing person resolved:** Lloyd William Yates, 89/90, of Tazewell (5’5”, 198 lbs, grey hair, brown eyes, walks with cane), was reported missing Wednesday morning after leaving home between 2:30–9:30 a.m. en route to Carilion Giles Community Hospital in Pearisburg. He was found safe Thursday in the Bluefield area. Tazewell Police Department. [OSINT - NEWS] [source](https://wcyb.com/news/local/tazewell-police-department-searching-for-90-year-old-man-who-has-dementia-lloyd-william-yates)[[1]](https://wcyb.com/news/local/tazewell-police-department-searching-for-90-year-old-man-who-has-dementia-lloyd-william-yates)
- **Bluefield shooting suspect arrested:** Hallie Graham was arrested in South Carolina on warrants for attempted first-degree murder, three counts of wanton endangerment, and malicious assault stemming from a Saturday morning shooting at Wild Riders Saloon in Bluefield that injured one person. She will be extradited to West Virginia. Bluefield Police Department. [OSINT - NEWS] [source](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/07/graham-reportedly-arrested-south-carolina/)[[2]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/07/graham-reportedly-arrested-south-carolina/)

Nothing else reported in the last 24 hours from Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office, Virginia State Police, Richlands/Tazewell/Bluefield VA/Cedar Bluff police, Mercer County Sheriff, or WV State Police.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
NWS alerts: none active. No flooding, winter weather, burn bans, power outages, boil-water notices, or VDOT/WVDOH closures reported on major routes.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
- Tazewell County Board of Supervisors approved the firefighter roster for a new countywide fire department serving unincorporated areas beginning October 15. Stations remain in place; training and procedures will be standardized. [OSINT - NEWS] [source](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/07/tazewell-county-approves-firefighter-list-new-countwide-department/)[[3]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/07/tazewell-county-approves-firefighter-list-new-countywide-department/)
- Supervisors voted to purchase a home and 12 acres near Cavitt’s Creek Park/Lake Witten for nearly $500,000. A Hope and Future Ministries will operate a 12-bed women’s opioid recovery center there, with operations expected next month. [OSINT - NEWS] [source](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/07/tazewell-county-buys-home-opioid-recovery-center/)[[4]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/07/tazewell-county-buys-home-opioid-recovery-center/)
